title: Investigate and fix with Grafana Assistant

blocks.content:
Hand the investigation to Grafana Assistant to confirm the root cause and open a fix.

> **Note:** Grafana Assistant is non-deterministic. Its exact responses vary between runs, so treat the following as a guide rather than a fixed script, and try it a few times before demoing.

Open **Assistant** and ask something like `What's going on here?`

Because Assistant is context-aware, it detects that Profiles Drilldown is open and reads the selected services, labels, and time ranges. That's why you can ask such a vague question.

Assistant summarizes the current view and offers next steps. Choose **Investigate any performance differences** so it digs into why `eu-west-1` differs.

It will determine that the issue is inefficient regular-expression usage that only runs in `eu-west-1`.

Ask Assistant to `Fix it`.

Using the GitHub integration against the [AppEnv mirror repo](https://github.com/grafana/field-eng-appenv-mirror), Assistant searches the code, reads the relevant files, and opens a pull request with a fix, then summarizes the changes. This step can take a little time.
You've gone from a vague "it's slow in some regions" report to a concrete code fix — without writing a single query.
